typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		VALUATION_DATE as timestamp,
		MEASURE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		MEASURE_VALUE as double,
		CURRENCY_CODE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(LOADDATE = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
OLEDBSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		MEASURE_ID as integer,
		MEASURE_VALUE as double,
		LOADDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TRADE_ID as integer,
		CURRENCY_CODE as string,
		VALUATION_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MEASURE_ID,
		MEASURE_VALUE,
		LOADDATE,
		TRADE_ID,
		CURRENCY_CODE,
		VALUATION_DATE),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
